outlook: CRITICAL (Day 27, Hour 18 UTC). Mixed signals: Iran's Hormuz commander Tangsiri killed (escalation) but 10 tankers released (de-escalation). Iran formally rejected US 15-point plan with 5-point counterproposal — both sides posturing ahead of Islamabad talks this weekend. Israel accelerates strikes anticipating diplomatic window may close. Russia-Ukraine: spring offensive intensifies as Iran war diverts US attention, Leningrad refinery hit. Ground ops signal: 82nd Airborne + Marines deployed to Gulf. Window for diplomacy exists but narrowing fast.
de_escalation_watch: DE-ESCALATION WATCH (Day 27, Hour 18 UTC). MIXED BUT TILTING TOWARD DE-ESCALATION. Iran released 10 tankers, ship attacks halted 7 days. Iran submitted counterproposal (5-point) — rejection but WITH conditions = negotiating posture. Araghchi + Ghalibaf reportedly off Pakistan kill list for Islamabad talks. However: Tangsiri assassination is a major escalation, 8th missile wave at Israel, Trump mixed messaging ('begging' + 'unleash hell'). Islamabad talks this weekend = critical inflection point. If they fail, expect rapid escalation.
